from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,itertools,json,os,shutil,subprocess
root=Path('target/native-captures/changed')
output=Path('target/native-paired-changed');output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
vector=json.loads((root/'request.json').read_text())
vector['database']=str((output/'runtime/kassiber.sqlite3').resolve())
request=output/'request.json';request.write_text(json.dumps(vector,separators=(',',':')))
probes={'wide':Path('target/journal-persist-wide'),'boxed':Path('target/journal-persist-boxed'),'singleton':Path('target/journal-persist-singleton')}
results=[]
for run,order in enumerate(itertools.permutations(probes)):
 trial={}
 for name in order:
  dest=output/'runtime'
  if dest.exists():shutil.rmtree(dest)
  shutil.copytree(root/'base',dest)
  load=os.getloadavg()
  process=subprocess.run([str(probes[name].resolve())],input=str(request)+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  result=json.loads(process.stdout)
  assert result['ok'], (name,result)
  trial[name]={'cpu_seconds':result['cpu_seconds'],'seconds':result['seconds'],'phases':result.get('phases'),'loadavg':load}
 results.append(trial)
 print(run,order,{k:v['cpu_seconds'] for k,v in trial.items()},flush=True)
 record={'scope':'Native changed 20k synthetic capture only; exact complete frozen Python dump checked for every operation. Fresh process and physical database copy for each operation. All six runtime permutations. Not the complete comparison matrix or a floor budget.','sources':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path(__file__),root/'request.json',root/'base/kassiber.sqlite3',*probes.values()]},'results':results,'best':{name:min(t[name]['cpu_seconds'] for t in results) for name in probes}}
 (output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 shutil.rmtree(dest)
